messages:
sam: Root cause summary: cold-start surge from a marketplace promo + model cache evictions triggered sustained GPU saturation and a few near-OOMs. We dropped throughput ~18% for ~14m. Looking for concise learnings and action items.

maria: Thanks. Timeline I have: 12:03: promo traffic spike -> 12:04 autoscaler started warm-up -> 12:06 large number of new model loads -> 12:07 KV cache eviction cascades -> 12:17 sustained 92-98% GPU util on pools -> 12:18 first throttling alarms.

alex: Short version: forecasting missed correlated cold starts. Our warm pool sizing is based on q95 traffic, but burst had high concurrency and large prompt sizes.

jordan: Metrics: peak queued requests +63%, mean seq_len increased from 512->1200, average tokens/sec per GPU bumped 1.8x. Logs show many loads of the 32B quantized variant concurrently.

rebecca: Cost note: the Dedicated burst had 2.4x token-cost for that hour due to repeated reloads. Rough back-of-envelope: +$12k incremental for EUW1 that day.

infra-bot: autoscaler:scale_event - triggered 24 new instances (type g5xlarge) at 12:05, completed 12:10. Estimated time-to-ready 300s. warm_pool_occupancy=0.14

sam: Main learnings I'm drafting:
- Warm pool needs to consider model load time & quant variant size not just qps
- Forecasting must include promotion scheduling metadata (marketing events)
- Autoscaler spin-up latency too high for this class of bursts
- Add backpressure + graceful degrade path to smaller model when OOM threatened

maria: Proposed mitigations:
1) Pre-warm policy for scheduled promos (manual or webhook from marketing)
2) Reduce spin-up by keeping a small standby of quantized models pinned (cost tradeoff)
3) Autoscaler tuning: faster scale up thresholds for concurrency spikes, add predictive scale based on forecast delta
4) Add a short-term KV cache TTL bump to avoid cascading eviction on burst

alex: Quick config snippet for a prewarm webhook we tested:
```
prewarm:
  trigger: external_webhook
  models: ["redwood-32b-quant", "redwood-8b-opt"]
  hold_for: 600  # seconds
  min_ready: 8
```

jordan: Action items assigned:
- maria: write runbook for promo prewarm + webhook (ETA: 24h)
- alex: prototype pinned-quant pool and cost model (ETA: 48h)
- rebecca: update forecasting team about promo metadata ingestion (ETA: 72h)
- sam: follow up on autoscaler spin-up improvements with infra (ETA: 1 week)

rebecca: Also recommend a retro note for sales/marketing: please post promo times to /promos API at least 1 hour ahead, else we consider burst a non-sched event and charge for overage.

ops: added incident label "coldstart-surge" and linked to runbook template. Put a 2-week priority on automations.

sam: thanks all. I'll collate these into a short incident report and circulate. If anyone has additional logs or traces drop them here or add to the incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1865001234

maria: attaching snippet of eviction trace:
```
[12:06:42] evict model redwood-32b-quant heap pressure 0.87
[12:06:47] load model redwood-32b-quant node gpu-13
[12:06:52] cache_miss key_prefix: conversational:usr:23452
```

alex: LGTM, also let's add a post-incident A/B: when promos are scheduled, route low-latency customers to smaller variants automatically.

sam: Agreed. Closing thread, will post final report tomorrow. :thumbsup:
